question: The length, breadth, and height of a room are 7 m, 5 m and 3 m, respectively. Find the cost of whitewashing the walls of the room and the ceiling at the rate of ₹16 per m².
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total area to paint = Area of 4 walls + Area of ceiling

Total area = 2 × h × (l + b) + (l × b)

Total area = 2 × 3 × (7 + 5) + (7 × 5) = 72 + 35 = 107 m²

Total Cost = 107 × 16 = ₹1,712

**∴ The correct answer is ₹1,712.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Length (l) = 7 m, Breadth (b) = 5 m, Height (h) = 3 m

Rate of whitewashing = ₹16 per m²

**Formula Used:**

Area of 4 walls (Lateral Surface Area) = 2h(l + b)

Area of ceiling = l × b

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a205cb136fcc4251132aeed39d770fdd00ddff73dad744a83415a499eb82bb3e.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Area of 4 walls = 2 × 3 × (7 + 5) m²

⇒ Area of 4 walls = 6 × 12 = 72 m²

⇒ Area of ceiling = 7 × 5 = 35 m²

⇒ Total area to be whitewashed = 72 + 35 = 107 m²

⇒ Total Cost = Total Area × Rate per m²

⇒ Total Cost = 107 × 16 = 1712

**∴ The correct answer is ₹1,712.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Total Surface Area of a Cuboid

Includes the area of all 6 rectangular faces: 2(lb + bh + hl).

Lateral Surface Area (Area of 4 walls)

Excludes the top (ceiling) and bottom (floor) faces: 2h(l + b).

Length of Longest Diagonal

The longest rod that can be placed inside a cuboidal room is its main diagonal: √(l² + b² + h²).
